**Input**: `spec.md` (re-drafted 2026-08-31), `design-baseline.md` (§8 added the same day)

two that are not done are external gates, named at the end.

> ## This file was re-drafted, and the old one is preserved below as a map
>
> The 2026-08-11 task list built `packages/transfers`, a `transfer_claims` table, a checkout payment
> method, a `transfer_reconciliation` authority and a new admin queue. `spec-BKTX` (2026-08-17) and

> the operator answered on 2026-08-21 (ADR-027).

> **§ Disposition of the original tasks** below accounts for all 48. Nothing was quietly dropped, and
> the ones that were genuinely superseded say by what.
